Mortgage.// DefaultMonthlyRate: Fallback monthly interest rate (percent) for the loan calculator when the live EVDS rate is unavailable.

Evds.// ApiKey: Free TCMB EVDS key from evds2.tcmb.gov.tr — set via user-secrets, not committed. Empty means: skip the live fetch and use DefaultMonthlyRate.
Evds.// HousingLoanSeries: EVDS series for the weighted-average housing (konut) loan rate; annual, converted to monthly.

Gemini.// ApiKey: Free Google AI Studio key (aistudio.google.com) — set via user-secrets, not committed. Empty means: natural-language search is off and search falls back to keyword matching.
Gemini.// Model: Free-tier model used to parse the search sentence into filters.
